demo_cases.title: Wide Search + Deep Read
demo_cases.objective: 展示 Deep Research 如何把 wide search 和 deep read 收敛为正式报告。
expected_highlights: Research Harness 驱动默认主链
Table-as-State 产生稳定 verified findings
最终报告与来源列表可直接展示
source_display_points: Workspace source 作为初始研究范围进入报告来源
verified findings 中可见 source_title 与 provenance
process_display_points: Search Timeline 展示 wide-to-deep 查询推进
Read Timeline 展示 bounded read window
audit_display_points: Verifier Gate 展示 READY_TO_WRITE / SYNTHESIZE_REPORT
Harness Control State 展示主链收敛状态

demo_cases.title: Conflict Counterfactual
demo_cases.objective: 展示冲突证据如何触发 verifier-gated 反证分支。
expected_highlights: Dual Verifier 将冲突研究收敛为 guarded write
反证分支显式参与路径纠偏
报告保留 conflict-aware 结论而不是简单平均
source_display_points: 冲突来源在 verified/conflict 相关结构中可见
counterfactual target evidence 与来源绑定可见
process_display_points: Search Timeline 可看到针对冲突的额外查询
Source Evidence Summary 可看到 conflict evidence
audit_display_points: Counterfactual Branch Summary 明确显示 has_counterfactual_recheck
Verifier Gate / Final Loop Decision 明确显示 guarded write

demo_cases.title: External Fetch Fallback
demo_cases.objective: 展示外部网页抓取失败或无 transport 时，系统如何保留 fallback 证据并完成报告。
expected_highlights: ResearchToolbox 暴露 fetch/read fallback 元数据
外部来源仍能进入正式报告链路
fallback 场景可解释、可展示
source_display_points: external source 在结果 payload 中保留 source_id / source_title / url
saved report downstream 可继续带出 generated provenance
process_display_points: Fetch Timeline 明确显示 FALLBACK_USED / NO_TRANSPORT
Read Timeline 明确显示 fallback read window
audit_display_points: audit summary 仍然完整可读
Harness Control State 能说明 fallback 下的写作决策
